We were a little disappointed that the summer opportunities I had hoped for my student were missed. We soon found out that there was a lack of communication on both parts. Nevertheless, things quickly changed when another counselor was brought on board. A proper plan was made. Deadlines were set along with goals. Task list was prioritized. And a good deal of discussions that should guide the student as to what schools would best suit her interest, how to start prepping for essays and getting constant feedback started. Once she was in Junior High, things changed. She also felt more open with the new counselor. It was unfortunate that the previous counselor could not help my student as expected. We are happy to say that we did find a great deal of support from Megan W. And I would recommend Empowerly to any student who wishes to find out what they want to do and how to traverse the tricky path of college applications. I would also suggest that if you are not happy with your selected counselor, please communicate early. They do have a lot to offer if your child gets the right person.

Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25kQ1NIWkRWMjlN.text:
We did a ton of research before choosing Empowerly as a college admissions counselor for my daughter.  Redditt, Google, online reviews, interviews, etc. We spent a lot of time with their immediate competitors and after a year, I am still happy with our choice.

If you are just starting this process, here is the short overview: There are really expensive programs that actually have some insight and maybe recognition with some of the top college programs. They are $50K plus.  If that is where you are playing, you have different problems than I do.  Then there are the large programs of which Empowerly is one.  All hire former admissions counselors.  Some are more data driven, some more experience driven. Then there are more local groups and individual counselors, which can be hit or miss - find a great one and you are much better off, but there are many duds.  There is also your child - do they need to chased down or are they a self starter.

Empowerly has a ton of information under its hood - their portal is full of information on schools, the admissions process, scholarship, selection, trackers and things we haven't even gotten into yet.  There is some real value there pulling that into one place.

But it comes down to the counselor you work with for what you get out of it.  We work with Brennan.  He has been great.  Approachable, informed, and realistic.  He isn't trying to make your kid into something they aren't and does a great job eliciting who they are and then translating that into what that might look like in a few years.  My daughter really gets along with him and the conversations sound really informal but there is a ton of information actually being conveyed in terms teens get.  But my point is don't book based on the service, book based on who they will work with.  And yes, your child will get a ton of face time and attention from their counselor.  Its not impersonal - quite the opposite.  Its a relationship with a counselor with a bunch of passive tools to play with, not the other way around. Also, one of my justifications for paying this amount is that it would keep me from killing my child, or the other way around, when applications finally need to get together.

I went with 4 stars just because you need to be on top of the portal and your child checking in with counselors...meaning that if you child has a tendency to wait to be told, they are going to be waiting for a long time.  Also, its easy for them to hide.  I am sympathetic.  We are asking so much of these kids, but if they don't want to sort all this out, they can melt through the cracks.  Also, we are just starting junior year so I suspect in a year we are going to be at 5 stars or 3.  Wish us luck.

We found Brennan through Empowerly, and he has made a real difference in our son's college application journey. He is actually the fourth counselor we've worked with. Our earlier experiences left us frustrated, and one even chipped away at our son's confidence instead of building it. So when we started with Brennan, we were worried. We weren't sure how colleges would look at his academic record, or whether we were guiding him the right way. Today we see our son as a different young man. He's more confident, more focused, and actually excited about where he might go to college. As parents, that means the world to us.

Brennan was honest with us from the very first meeting. He told us and our son exactly where things stood and what was realistic. But he never left it there. He followed it with encouragement and pushed our son to aim high and believe he could get there.

Our son had a hard sophomore year, and his grades took a hit. He worked his way back in junior year with a very challenging course load. Brennan helped us understand how to explain that period in his applications so that one rough year doesn't tell his whole story. More than anything, he helped our son see what he's capable of.

He is also very organized. Over the summer, he and our son made a plan to finish the UC essays first and then move on to the Common App and school-specific essays. They meet every week, and the UC essays are already done. After each meeting, Brennan sends us a summary, so we know what they worked on and what's next. We don't have to keep asking our son about it, which has made things a lot easier at home.

Before building the college list, Brennan sat down with us as parents to talk about our priorities, including what we could afford. We liked that he looked at the whole picture.

College admissions can be stressful for the whole family, and choosing the right counselor is the key in this whole process. Having Brennan as our counselor has given us real peace of mind. We're not at the finish line yet, but we're so grateful we found him.

Shahrukh is also extremely responsive and prompt, which we truly appreciate as parents. Most importantly, he genuinely cares about his students and their success. We’re very grateful for his support and highly recommend Shahrukh and Empowerly to any family navigating the college process.

Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tWU2RVaFRXVEZC.author: Swetha Polamreddy
Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tWU2RVaFRXVEZC.text:
Betty at Empowerly has been a fantastic counselor for our daughter. From our very first conversation, she took the time to understand our daughter as a whole person, including her academic strengths, her extracurricular interests, and where she wanted to go long term.

Where Betty really stood out was as a strategist. She gave us clear, specific guidance on which courses our daughter should take inside and outside of school to strengthen her profile, and she helped us think through how to elevate her extracurriculars, including the nonprofit work our daughter was already running. That kind of specific, actionable advice is rare.

One of our daughter's weaknesses was juggling a pile of work at once, and she would occasionally miss a deadline. Betty picked up on this early and started sending consistent reminders to keep her on track. That kind of attentiveness went well beyond what we expected and genuinely changed how our daughter managed her applications.

Betty was also consistently prompt herself. Questions got answered quickly, essay drafts came back with thoughtful feedback, and nothing ever slipped. With her guidance, our daughter was admitted to the selective summer programs she applied to and also earned scholarship support along the way.

We plan to continue working with Betty through junior and senior year, which is the strongest endorsement we can give. If you are looking for a counselor who is genuinely invested in your child and knows how to build a strong, differentiated profile, Betty is the one.

Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pRMmRUbGFkbGhs.author: Ramit Kanda
Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pRMmRUbGFkbGhs.text:

Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2poSFpuSlZZMDFN.text:

What I appreciate most is how my child has become more responsible and proactive. Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT213eU5qSk1NVzFY.author: Finley Lewis
Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT213eU5qSk1NVzFY.text:
I worked with Mary T,  and she was extremely helpful, guiding me to find the schools that best suited me and helping me get into them! At the start of the college application process, I had ambition, but I wasn’t sure how to navigate it. I started working with Mary during my sophomore year of high school, and she encouraged me to explore my interests and continue my education in ways I hadn’t known about, such as research projects, summer programs, and later on, scholarships. She helped me build a school list that we constantly refined based on the programs and organizations each school offered that I could benefit from.

In the summer before senior year, she walked me through writing a high-quality personal statement for the Common App and then my supplements. Throughout our time together, she guided me in making my application consistent and in telling an overall story about the clubs I was involved in, the classes I took, and my career goals.

We met weekly during my senior year to review essays. She is always very responsive, knows what specific schools look for, and draws out your own voice in your writing in a way that genuinely reflects your personality and values.

Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21OaGMwd3RkMGRo.author: Amy Lin
Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21OaGMwd3RkMGRo.text:
Snaky staff who do not actually care about the level of effort required from parents and students or value delivered. They just want your money, duh. I don’t know why I was led to believe otherwise.

They’re a high volume shop delivering low value, generic guidance. Pushy sales people. Remote ONLY counselors. Not worth $1800 a month or $22k+ for two and a half years. No phone number to call. They filter you through an email alias blackhole.

Once you sign, they will REFUSE to let you out of your contract for the next 2.5 years or however long your student has until graduation. They have a 60 day cancellation/refund policy and even if you try to cancel within this period, they will send you in circles until this period has passed and lock you into their program.

Empowerly team - cancel my contract, effective immediately.

Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pWUE9URXpVVVpo.author: Aren
Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pWUE9URXpVVVpo.text:
We cannot explain how grateful we are to Mr. Ronnie Medure for his expertise and the care he has devoted to helping us. It’s clear that Mr. Medure knows every one of his students extremely well. He has never rewritten anything or mocked my writing; instead, he teaches me how to advocate for myself with my own voice. It is incredible how he pushed me to use my own voice to properly reflect my authentic self. It genuinely improved the cohesiveness, memorability, and appeal of each essay. If nothing else, your student will become a better writer by the end of it all. The best proof of his capabilities is that he guided me to getting accepted into Caltech.

College admissions can be confusing, but my counselor helped ease the stress. I worked with Mr. Medure, who was extremely easy to work with and very knowledgeable. Whenever I had a question, I emailed him at any time, and he responded promptly and cleared up any misunderstandings. He has also been very honest and supportive throughout the entire process. Whenever I had doubts, he always found the right words to say. While he believed in and pushed me, he was also very realistic and made sure I understood how to properly make a college list with enough safeties (I even had too many at one point). Through all this, Mr. Medure helped my family make informed decisions every step of the way and even broke things down for us so we didn’t feel overwhelmed.

I highly recommend Mr. Medure for any student. He genuinely has your student’s best interests in mind. In fact, he gets just as invested in your student’s success as you do. One of the things he strongly believes in is making sure that every family feels like they aren’t alone in the college application process. He has consistently gone above and beyond what is expected of him every week. He has even given up his free time to give me extra help!

Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tabFRHeHFhMHcz.author: Pax
Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tabFRHeHFhMHcz.text: Our experience with Empowerly has been wonderful. Our counselor is Betty, and she has gone above and beyond what we expect. She has been proactive in identifying what needs to be done next, including scholarship searches, follow-ups for letters of continued interest, and interview preparation. I would highly recommend Empowerly and especially Betty for college admissions preparation. Our only regret is that we should have started sooner. Thank you, Empowerly.

Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21SV2NFTjZUVVYw.author: Arun R
Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21SV2NFTjZUVVYw.text:
Empowerly was invaluable in guiding my daughter through the college application process.

The Platform: Empowerly's database of essays and student profiles (including GPAs and SAT scores of accepted students) helped my daughter realistically assess her chances at various colleges. She applied to schools she wouldn't have considered based solely on common dataset averages and acceptance rates. The platform made it easy to research college rankings, narrow her list, and schedule counselor sessions and AdCom reviews—all hassle-free.

The Counselor: Lisa, my daughter's counselor, was fantastic. My daughter left every session feeling motivated and uplifted. The college process is overwhelming and stressful, but Lisa made it so manageable that my daughter wondered why everyone else seemed so stressed. She completed all her applications well ahead of schedule and actually enjoyed the experience.

I highly recommend Empowerly for both its comprehensive resources and exceptional counseling support.

Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pST2JFSk9OWEIw.author: Jeannie Lee
Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2pST2JFSk9OWEIw.text:
Empowerly stands out with their services, like AdCom Review and Essay Edits. My son worked with Mr. Ronnie Medure. If you can chose your counselor you will not find a finer advocate for your student.  My son just got accepted to Tufts!  Throughout this whole college journey Mr Medure has been encouraging and extremely patient  He has a tremendous amount of insights into every college and the whole industry.

Mr Medure recognized that my son had a real talent for math. He suggested research and a Multi-Variable Calculus course at UCSD. I believe this gave my son an edge in his application. He also nudged him to improve his SAT score and he ended up with a 1550. One of the best things about Mr Medure is that he is honest, in a tactful way, like if you are aiming way too high or putting too much pressure on your kid.  He will push back because he genuinely cares about them. Lastly, I must have emailed him five times a week, for three years, with anxious questions. He responded promptly and calmly with brilliant solutions. He doubles as a therapist and I recommend Mr Ronnie Medure without hesitation.

Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xaaGVWbDRaMnBr.author: Grace2016
Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xaaGVWbDRaMnBr.text:
Empowerly has been an outstanding partner in my son’s college application journey. From the start, Lucie and Shannon reconnected us with an excellent counselor, Ms. Katharine, and I’m incredibly grateful for that.

Katharine has been exceptional throughout the entire essay and application process. She is patient, wise, kind, knowledgeable, efficient, and very flexible—always working around my son’s busy schedule. She made every step of the personal statement, essay revisions, and applications manageable and far less stressful. Her guidance helped my son improve structure, clarity, and authentic storytelling without ever rewriting his work. She truly brings out the student’s own voice at the finalized essays.

Because of her support, my son felt more confident, and our whole family experienced a significant reduction in stress. We deeply appreciate her professionalism, warmth, and dedication.

Empowerly’s additional resources—such as academic, extracurricular, and essay evaluations, scholarship summaries, and summer program suggestions—were also extremely valuable. These tools provided personalized feedback and helped us feel fully prepared for submission. I only wish my son had started with Empowerly earlier, even as a freshman. Their resources are incredibly helpful not only for college applications but also for early high school planning and development.

Choosing Empowerly was one of the best decisions I made. Their team listens, cares, is highly experienced, and truly brings out the best in their students. I’m thankful for Lucie, Shannon, and especially Katharine. With two more children in high school, we will definitely return.

Thank you, Empowerly!

We are super thankful to have the support and expertise of the Empowerly team to help navigate this highly complex and stressful application process. From the initial sign-up in 2024 to date, Empowerly have provided exceptional service. When we first started, we wanted the best counselor match for our daughter and Jeff was instrumental in this process by helping us set up many interviews w/ different counselors until we found the best fit. Also, their proprietary tool is easy to use and contains a lot of valuable information.

Mary, our daughter's counselor, is experienced, knowledgeable, personable and flexible (she oftentimes accommodate last minute sessions, even on weekends). We've had a truly fantastic experience working with Empowerly, especially with our son Aarav's counselor, Katharine Chu. Honestly, we couldn't be happier.

Katharine isn't trying to jam Aarav into some cookie-cutter applicant profile; she's building the entire strategy around Aarav's actual strengths and passions.

Instead, she shows him clear, concrete examples of the work, commitment, and impact top colleges expect, then helps him map out a smart path to get there. If you're looking for college counseling, we wholeheartedly recommend Empowerly, and Katharine Chu in particular. Their commitment to treating your child as an individual—their voice, their goals, their interests—makes all the difference in this stressful process.

Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT25ReE9VbDVMVTFz.text:
We’ve been working with Empowerly, and specifically with our son Aarav’s college counselor, Shahrukh — and we could not be happier with the experience.

From day one, Shahrukh has taken the time to really understand who Aarav is: what he’s interested in, what he’s genuinely excited by, and what he wants for himself long-term. His guidance is not generic or checkbox-driven. Instead of trying to force Aarav into a cookie-cutter profile, he builds around Aarav’s actual strengths and passions.

What we appreciate most is the balance he brings. He’s incredibly encouraging and motivating, but he’s also honest. He doesn’t sugarcoat how difficult it is to get into Aarav’s dream schools. He shows Aarav clear examples of what it takes — the level of work, the depth of commitment, and the type of impact top schools are looking for — and then helps him map out how to get there. That combination of support and realism has been invaluable. Shahrukh is also intentional about helping Aarav grow, not just “package” himself. He highlights what Aarav already does well, while actively pushing him to strengthen areas of opportunity.

We would highly recommend Empowerly, and especially Shahrukh, to any family. They focus on your child as an individual — their interests, their voice, their goals — and that makes all the difference.

ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUNZZ2VYODlBRRAB.text:
Working with Shahrukh at Empowerly has been one of the most impactful parts of my transfer journey—and honestly, even beyond just college applications. As someone who’s navigated the stressful and often overwhelming process of transferring, I can confidently say that Shahrukh made it not only manageable but also meaningful.

Let’s start with the obvious—he’s worth every penny. In a market where prices can be outrageous, Shahrukh and Empowerly come in as surprisingly affordable, but that doesn't mean you're getting any less. In fact, you’re getting the best. Shahrukh stands out not just within Empowerly but in this entire space. His combination of empathy, expertise, and insight is incredible.

There was one specific moment that really showed me who he is. I was under a massive time crunch—only 2 days left to submit my application to the Kelley School of Business, and I was stressed out and unsure of how I’d pull it off. Despite being swamped with other commitments, Shahrukh dove in immediately. He didn’t complain once, didn’t rush me, and made sure everything got done—not just done, but done well. He was calm, focused, and completely in my corner. That moment alone solidified my trust in him.

What really sets Shahrukh apart is that he’s not just a college counselor. He’s a sounding board for your career, your aspirations, your doubts, and your strengths. He doesn’t just help you get into college—he helps you understand yourself better. I’ve never been the best writer, but Shahrukh helped me brainstorm so well that I ended up writing a strong essay and using the same brainstorming session to build out my resume. He brings structure to your chaos and helps you find clarity.

One of the most memorable sessions I had with him was a creative brainstorming exercise for UIUC. I was sleepy, so I closed my eyes and just spoke freely about what was on my mind. I did—rambled, vented, thought out loud—and when I opened my eyes, I saw that Shahrukh had been typing the entire time. He turned my scattered thoughts into a beautifully articulated story and said, “This is amazing. We’ve got a great essay here.” That moment wasn’t just about the essay—it helped me find direction. It helped me see my own story as valuable, and that’s something I’ll carry far beyond college.

Even though I ultimately decided not to proceed with transferring, I do not regret investing in Empowerly, as my sessions with Shahrukh gave me something more important: clarity. He helped me align my ambitions with reality, explore new possibilities, and define a path that makes sense for me. That’s rare. That’s powerful.

If you’re looking for someone who genuinely cares, listens deeply, and can guide you not just through college admissions but through life decisions, Shahrukh is your guy.
P.S. Even after our package officially ended, Shahrukh kindly offered to stay in touch and support me whenever I needed help— (Interviews, Resume, etc) now that’s what a true counselor looks like!

ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURWbks2Z2RREAE.text:

ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURKbXQtcFhnEAE.author: Rithik Bhat
ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURKbXQtcFhnEAE.text: Empowerly has done a really amazing job at guiding me throughout highschool process. My counselor has most definetly opened my eyes into the many oppurtunites I can take advantage of, to give me an upper hand.

ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR4MHFucnNnRRAB.author: Pratyush Verma
ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUR4MHFucnNnRRAB.text: My counselor Ms. Lara Andersen helped me in ways that I couldn't even have dreamed about. I initially struggled before my admissions process, with a family emergency coupled with bad company affecting my grades big time. As I went on to apply as an Aerospace Engineering Major, I started with three C's in AP Stem courses, and in my junior year. It is safe to say I struggled. Prior to joining Empowerly, I even had college admission counselor who laughed and mocked me, telling me to drop courses I was getting C's in (during the middle of the year on top of that). Empowerly, and specifically Ms. Lara Andersen were basically the lifeboats to a sinking ship (me). Ms. Andersen was really easy to open up to, and she helped me through not only the college admissions process, but with myself and my load as well. I struggled with tests and test taking in general, I didn't get a single four or five on an AP Exam, and I got an SAT of 1240, which I decided to go test optional with. Ms.Andersen helped me organize my thoughts and helped me brainstorm the essays that got me into the schools I least expected. She didn't judge me or make me feel like I put myself down due to the circumstances that led to my struggling grades. Most of all she was encouraging, even in moments where I was stressed out she made it known that it was my responsibility to establish my application in a way that would represent me, and my values. She also made it known that she was not going to parent me around and that I had the responsibility to ensure that I was putting my best foot forward prior to submitting my essays. Although Empowerly as a company had some cons (Please DO NOT invest in the Ad Coms), Ms. Andersen, made it known that I was going to be supported throughout my admissions process. As for Cons, I would say the company has some problems, for example they charge and outrageous amount for Adcoms which are mock admissions reviews, but do not provide any valuable feedback. My counselor was actually able to provide me with better feedback than the AdCom reviews. Another piece of advice I would give for anyone who is thinking about joining Empowerly is that the sooner you join the better. It is important to know whether your counselor is a good fit or not before he or she help you with the college admissions process. Starting earlier would help you get an understanding in terms of how helpful your counselor is, and if they are able to take the steps to go above and beyond to help you succeed. Because truly if it wasn't for my amazing counselor, I wouldn't have gotten the offers I did from the colleges I applied to. If I recommend anything, if you faced the same struggles as me, as far as grades go and have the dreams and the will to do whatever it takes to get into your dream school, please book an appointment with Empowerly and maybe attempt to request Ms. Lara Andersen as she has the experience and the perseverance to make sure her students will end up in their dream school if they put the work and time into it. As of now, I'm committed to the UCI Samueli School of Engineering as an aerospace engineering major, and my parents couldn't be more proud, I couldn't be happier, and I have to thank my counselor for helping me figure out what I'm truly capable of.

ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUN4a3VMdjNBRRAB.text: I honestly was pretty skeptical with having a counselor due to multiple factors including price and actual results. ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSURSdUlmenhBRRAB.text:
I am a high school senior, and I had a 80-20 experience with Empowerly. Here is a summary:

Pros:
- Great research team - Most of the questions I asked were fulfilled relatively quickly and much in depth.
- Essay Team (Pro & Con) - The essay team made very insightful comments that I believed improved my essays. They also have a nice "essay score" system.
- Price - For what it's worth, I think that the package is decently priced. (They offer a good discount over the summer)
- Counselor - My counselor, Mrs. Venturini was very supportive and kind in my college application journey. She was also very helpful in improving my resume and reviewing my essays.
- Help/CS team - The customer care I received was very helpful, quick, and effective. For instance, I was able to transfer officer reviews to more essay words.

Cons:
- Essay Team (Pro & Con) - The essay team is very inconsistent with some suggestions. For example, I submitted an essay once, revised it to cater the initial edits, and then got a significantly worse score. (This is also due to the subjectivity of readers.)
I also noticed that sometimes my essays would be returned in ~5 minutes, meaning that the person reading them simply skimmed over them.
- User Interface - While the vital things (like setting up a meeting, submitting research questions, and essay editing) are very easy to access, the rest of the platform is both confusing and
- Timing relation to usefulness - In my opinion, if you want the "counseling" part of this to be effective, you should start using this service earlier in the high school career. I started as a senior, and wished I had started earlier so my counselor would've instilled a sense of urgency into me to do more as a freshman/sophomore. My counseling was mostly essay related.

Our college list consisted of 11 schools.  This meant one HUGE Common App essay (650 words - extremely important!!) and then each school had at least 2 Supplementals/essays per school.  That meant about 14 essays to compete before all the deadlines.

Working with our essay consultant at Empowerly meant my son was able to perfect his essays with a highly educated college specialist with years of personal knowledge of each school, then utilize the essay editing service at Empowerly with additional eyes yet again on each essay providing editing and revisions on each essay.    Other services I looked at promised to turn around edited and revised essays in 3 days. Three days??!!!  There is no time for this slow turnaround.  Not Empowerly!!  Empowerly had each essay back edited and revised within 3 hours.  It's incredible!!  When you are under the gun and rushing to finish essays and have multiple eyes view them, this essay service is UNMATCHED!!

I honestly can't believe how amazing Empowerly is both by working one-on-one with our most amazing personal essay consultant.  His expertise was extraordinary!  And the essay editing service is something out-of-this-world that I can't praise enough!!  I love Empowerly!!  Thank you for getting my son into his Target school.  We could not have done this without your amazing service/product.
